speech.about: 22 s of macOS text-to-speech, 4 "Hey Snips" among 3 other phrases, looped by Chrome

steps.name: wakes on the spoken Hey Snips, and only on them
steps.check: (() => { const n = document.querySelectorAll('#hits > *').length; return { fail: (n < 3 || n > 5) && `${n} hits in one 22 s loop of 4 wake words`, info: `${n} hits, ${document.getElementById('stats').textContent}` }; })()
